doc.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Upcoming calendar: Vero Beach, Jerry Jerome record, Atlanta and the Carlyle
summary: Tate lists upcoming concerts and records, his first time off from Short, and the quiet phone.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s going to be on your calendar for the upcoming — the same?

Bobby Short starts, we are in mid-March now as we speak and Bobby starts, well I’m going this coming Tuesday, today being Saturday, I’m going down to Vero Beach with Ruby Braff and Bill Charlap and a couple of other fellas, I don’t even who the con— we’re going to go down there and do a concert. And then we come back here and record Thursday and Friday with Jerry Jerome who is 89. Dick Hyman is writing the music for it. Tommy Newsom is on it and some of the folks in this festival here. And then next month I’m going to Atlanta. I actually, we were supposed to start the Carlyle in early May and I booked a big jazz party in Atlanta with a record date in front, a record date on the back end of it, and a Sunday night concert with Ed Polcer in addition to it. So there was some pesos involved. And so this is the first time I’ve ever taken off from Bobby. I © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
told him, I’ve got this booked, I can’t get out of it. And so I’m actually sending a sub into the Carlyle for three nights. I’m going to hear about that.
I hope he doesn’t do too well.
Well I do too. I’m going to get somebody who can’t make it at all. I was always told send in somebody better. Cover your gig. I don’t buy that at all. I just send in some bum.
He’ll be so glad to see you.

Yeah right. No I’ve got somebody, the truth is someone good is going in. But I’m doing that and then back to the Carlyle until the end of June. And then Bobby goes to France and I freelance. I just start working the phones. The phone doesn’t ring as much now. First of all the business is a little odd these days, but everybody assumes I’m busy with Bobby so it’s kind of my fault. I don’t call enough people so I’ve got to get my network re-opened.
Right. I’ve heard people talk about that, that people think that you’re always working with somebody and they don’t bother to give you a ring.
Right. Or they think well let’s call somebody who isn’t working so much that needs the gig. I need the gig. Are you watching? Anybody that’s out there, help me.
